summary: iter_30 (NEW forgot-password 'set then confirm' flow + Dashboard cleanup: central pill removed, email moved to top-right UserMenu, sidebar-profile-pill removed). BACKEND 9/9 PASS on first run (all endpoints working end-to-end). FRONTEND all acceptance checks PASS: forgot-mode toggle, confirm-password input, inline mismatch + toast, forgot-back, dashboard UserMenu shows email top-right, central online/offline pill GONE, sidebar-profile-pill GONE, 3 sidebar buttons intact (Mon profil + Switch account + Logout red), wrong-password inline red error still works (iter_29 regression OK).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py L1198-1264 /api/auth/forgot-password — clean new flow. Validates password ≥6 chars, returns neutral message to prevent email enumeration, rate-limits 3/10 min, stores hash of new password on the token rather than changing the password immediately. Good defense: unverified accounts silently return the neutral response. Token TTL 30 min, single-use, kicks all user_sessions + failed_logins on confirm (defense in depth).

server.py L1267-1332 /api/auth/confirm-password-reset — returns friendly localized HTML (Lien invalide / Lien déjà utilisé / Lien expiré / Lien obsolète / ✅ Mot de passe mis à jour) with meta refresh auto-redirect to /login after 3s. Consumed-token check is correct (checks consumed_at first). One minor NIT: the html_page helper embeds user-supplied `title`/`body` into HTML without escaping — low risk here because callers use only constants, but worth an `html.escape()` for defense-in-depth.

Login.js — 'forgot' mode wiring is clean: mode state = 'login'|'signup'|'forgot', confirmPassword state cleared on transitions, regular auth-submit-btn hidden via `mode !== 'forgot'`, new forgot-submit-btn shown in forgot mode. Inline mismatch helper text renders only when both fields non-empty and mismatched. handleForgotPassword posts {email, password, frontend_url}. All 4 new data-testids present: auth-confirm-password-input, forgot-submit-btn, forgot-password-btn, forgot-back-btn.

UserMenu.jsx — trigger now shows email text instead of name; avatar fallback uses email[0]. Concatenated render shows 'T' initial + 'test_dash_1777658375@gmail.com' which reads as 'Ttest_dash_…' in flat textContent but visually the initial is inside the avatar circle (screenshot confirms).

Dashboard.js — verified by DOM scan: no element with text 'En ligne' / 'Hors ligne' / 'Online' / 'Offline' above the H2 ('What would you like to do?'). sidebar-profile-pill testid returns null. 3 sidebar buttons (sidebar-profile-btn, sidebar-switch-account-btn, sidebar-logout-btn) all present. Logout button has bg-red-500/10 border-red-500/40 text-red-400 (red family confirmed).

context_for_next_testing_agent: iter_30 verified end-to-end on preview URL. (A) Backend — POST /api/auth/forgot-password: happy path returns {message: 'Si un compte existe…', email_sent: true} (RESEND is LIVE in this env so `confirm_link` is NOT returned). 400 when password <6 chars with detail containing '6 caractères'. 429 on 4th call within 10 min (rate-limit enforced). GET /api/auth/confirm-password-reset returns HTML: invalid token → 'Lien invalide', valid token → '✅ Mot de passe mis à jour' + meta refresh to /login, reused token → 'Lien déjà utilisé'. After confirm, login with NEW password succeeds and OLD password returns 401. user_sessions + failed_logins are wiped. (B) Frontend Login forgot mode — forgot-password-btn switches mode, shows email + password + auth-confirm-password-input + forgot-submit-btn ('Envoyer le lien de confirmation') + forgot-back-btn ('← Retour à la connexion'). Regular auth-submit-btn is correctly HIDDEN in forgot mode. Inline mismatch text 'Les mots de passe ne correspondent pas.' renders under confirm field in real-time. Submitting mismatched passwords triggers toast 'Les deux mots de passe ne correspondent pas.' (C) Dashboard — user-menu-trigger (top-right) now contains full email text 'test_dash_1777658375@gmail.com' (avatar initial 'T' + email). No central 'En ligne'/'Hors ligne'/'Online'/'Offline' pill element anywhere near the H2 (DOM scan count=0). sidebar-profile-pill testid = null. sidebar-profile-btn + sidebar-switch-account-btn + sidebar-logout-btn all present; logout has red-500 family classes. (D) Regression — inline red auth-error still fires on wrong password ('Incorrect password' shown with data-testid='auth-error'). Password file /app/memory/test_credentials.md unchanged — credential is Pass1234 (restored). Note: because RESEND is live, the backend pytest file fetches the token directly from MongoDB (localhost) — next agent should keep this helper if re-running.
rca_of_the_issue: No bugs found in iter_30. Implementation matches the spec exactly: forgot-password stores pending hash on token, confirm-password-reset applies it and auto-redirects to /login. Dashboard UI cleanup executed cleanly (central pill + sidebar pill both removed; email relocated to UserMenu trigger). All 9 backend tests + all 9 frontend acceptance criteria pass on first run. The subsequent pytest re-run hit rate-limit 429 (expected: 3/10 min per email) which itself validates the rate-limit defense; the initial run's 9/9 PASS captured the full roundtrip and password restoration.
